content.overview: A mortgage transfers an interest in specific immovable property to secure a debt or a pecuniary engagement.
content.study: Name the species: simple, conditional sale, usufructuary, English, deposit of title-deeds, or anomalous. Sale with a reconveyance is not automatically a mortgage. Redemption and foreclosure follow later sections.
